verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway is an API/AI traffic gateway product, not an event-driven system for end users to subscribe to via webhooks; its role is proxying, governing, and observing LLM/MCP/A2A traffic, not offering webhook-based event subscription as a user-facing feature. No evidence in the pack even mentions webhooks or event subscription, and this axis is a category mismatch for a gateway of this kind.
